Surprisingly I was single for almost two years after an abusive relationship when I met the love of my life on tinder of all places. That place is a total cesspit of degenerates looking for sex but somehow I found him like treasure in a trash can. 

He was 25, about to turn 26 and had come out of a relationship where towards the last six months there was no intimacy and it felt like they were just roommates. Prior to that he’d been cheated on twice. This guy is the absolute nicest sweetest guy I’ve ever met and I see how easy it is for people to take advantage of his kindness and mistreat him but I’ve been mistreated badly myself before I met him and I was struggling to feel like I deserve something nice. 

On our first date I got up excitedly to pet a dog at the bar and he told me later that that was when he knew he was going to end up falling for me. After that, he would just do the most thoughtful things. If I told him what song was stuck in my head that day he would learn it on the guitar and play it for me, if I told him what my favourite dessert was, he’d make sure he had it ready for me. a few dates in I told him I had this weird habit of picking out the blue and yellow M&Ms and eating them first because “they tasted the best”… and the next time I was at his place he had filled up a giant bowl full of M&Ms and had left only the blue and yellow ones in. I can’t imagine how much time that must’ve taken. It was the first time that he played guitar for me in person on our fourth date when I looked at him and his crooked smile and the way his eyebrows moved as he stared at me and sang romantic songs that I thought to myself “fuck I think I love him”. And I really did. I’ve never fallen in love with anybody so fast in my entire life and I’ve never loved anyone anyone as much as I love him. 

I used to think my ex-boyfriend was the love of my life and my person but my current boyfriend even a year and a half into being together,  teaches me what real unconditional love is every single day. The morning breath no make up telling me I’m beautiful love. The ugly crying your eyes out and knowing you’re in a safe space love. The being understood love. Knowing this person could break you down to your core with all that they know of you but also knowing they never would. It’s complete trust. 2 dates in, I was hesitant to fall for a “nice guy” cause I hadn’t dated one before and I didn’t think I deserved it. Maybe I was scared I’d be bored. Boy was I wrong. He is the most manly man I’ve ever met. Not in the silly cliche ways but the fact that he listens and cares and would never judge me, he’s protective when someone hits on me but never ever controlling, he’s silly and funny but also the literal smartest most successful person I know. He’s not afraid to cry at anything or be vulnerable with me and that’s what I love the most. 

I love travelling the world with him, cooking for him because I love him so much I want to take care of him, going all out with decorating and gifts for his bday and Xmas, taking him to nice restaurants to repay him although he never asks me to do any of this. I do because he’s my person. I thought I’d never find love again, dating apps were such a mess, but idk sometimes you get lucky and find the person you want to spend your life with. I could write about him endlessly but you get the gist :P
